list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this pops on its own — no extra task, no online play, no DLC. Budget roughly 200 hours: the story, the 100% checklist, then cleanup. Use this guide's checklist to track everything.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. Pure story progress, impossible to miss.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. It pops when Chapter 2 opens with the mission What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. It pops when Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. It pops after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. It pops after the chapter's final mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the story's final mission. Just play through to the end — no side content is needed for this one.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory. Story progress only, cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, unlocked after the story). It is far more forgiving than it sounds — about 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals, finish 70 of 80 challenges, and complete every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Progress made during the story already counts, and nothing toward 100% is missable.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. For the 100% checklist you need 300, so keep going past this trophy. Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest. Track progress under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. The game tracks them under Touchpad > Progress > Activities, and activities are marked with blue icons on the map. You will do most of them naturally while chasing other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges across 12 range locations. The medals are needed in full for the 100% checklist too, so there is no shortcut — practice each range until gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.goal: Win at all 14 drone race locations
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 races in total). Every location's races are required for the 100% checklist as well, so you cannot skip any of them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, so pick the ones that suit your driving. Race wins also feed the 100% checklist's race challenges.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.goal: Beat Cal at fishing, west of Key Lento
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot west of Key Lento with a purple icon. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish all its levels once; you do not need to beat every challenge. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home (from Chapter 1), and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline — 5 quests, Lucia only, starting in Chapter 3 when Andy calls and texts her address in Belville: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass. All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline: clear 7 shipwrecks by diving for his treasures — he marks them on the map, and you use the metal detector to dig them from the ocean floor — then bring them back to his shop in Key Lento. His quests start in Chapter 1 after Island Dreams. He goes quiet for a while after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds it up. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline — 5 quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County, marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. Only certain strangers count — confirmed: Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), and Pilot Pete (deliveries). Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do NOT count toward this trophy. All strands are still available in free-roam after the story; check your count on the trophy tracker.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline: after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS you get the Key Cloner and deliver the Zorrusso to Randy, who hands you a wish list of 16 sports cars to steal and deliver to his garage in west Vice City. Track it under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List. Sports cars turn up most often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, and delivering one in good condition pays more.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline — Jason only, starting in Chapter 3 after Here, Kitty Kitty. Destroy the Synthetic Labs marked in Vice City (Take Out Kitty Litter), then Tyrone gives you Spin On This. All available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations (Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations). Meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. THE ONE MISSABLE: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and choose Accept. That meditation is gone for good after Chapter 1, and it is still unclear whether it counts toward the trophy, so do it to be safe. The last spot only opens once you can play both characters together (after Chapter 2's Coffee Break). For the 100% checklist you only need 15 of 18.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — Jason gets a text marking Veteran Hunted in Lummox County (Jason only). Bret gives you the Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. His 15 Target Decks are all required for the 100% checklist, so you will finish this naturally along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game; for the 100% checklist you need 15 of them, so keep collecting well past this trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1): landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags. There are more than 100 in the world, so scan whichever you pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — pick the easiest ones and leave the hardest 10 untouched. Track under Progress > Challenges.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.goal: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level with your partner and escape the heat. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break — call your partner (hold Right + Triangle), cause chaos to 4 stars, then escape the red heat zone; a fast sports bike through traffic works, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes helicopters. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… and the bank vault robberies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.goal: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Keep the flashing wanted level (not the red heat level), wear an armored vest, carry sticky bombs and healing items, and loot 3 green-icon robbery targets in a row — the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so hit a fourth if it does not. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) are a good spot.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Use the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) to scan vehicles — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. There are 557 vehicles at launch; the 100% checklist needs 200 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming). It slows time and drains the purple focus bar — buff focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline, and use an assault rifle like the Duke 556 at a gang operation. It does not count against soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.goal: Steal a docked plane at VCIA, fly 1 km away
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — not the planes on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence, climb the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, go up to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.goal: Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base — drive through the gate or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, get in and shoot until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry store robberies. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun (do not kick it), find the safe code note in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot. The trophy pops shortly after you leave.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which teaches the routine: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to carry a second bag. After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips (after his 2 Payday Loans). Vaults pay up to $205,000 each and instantly trigger 4 stars — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch cars. There are 8 large bank jobs; all 8 are needed for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.goal: Rob an armored truck and escape
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults (That's Where The Money Is…) counts as one — tail the truck to the bank and rob the vault. Or block a truck driving near a bank in Vice City, sticky-bomb its back door, and escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged area until the map is visible.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Operations are marked with yellow icons when you go near them; track each gang under Progress > Gangs. You only need one per gang for this trophy, but all 39 operations are required for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.goal: Apple Martini at Ocean View Rooftop Bar
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it standing next to the bar with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.goal: Blue Banshee through the showroom window
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs first. It only pops with this specific Banshee — a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation, marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling): the Luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe in the north-east hallway office — blow it with sticky bombs (buy them at Ammu-Nation first). The trophy pops after you escape the police. Not missable: the robbery icon respawns, so you can come back for anything you missed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. Work out at fitness clubs (filter Map > Activities) and always bring your partner — while one trains, the other progresses too. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile) so you see the demon icon whenever something counts. Robberies and enemy encounters all count — it happens passively while chasing other trophies. Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes cops far more aggressive.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — no published guide has confirmed how this unlocks yet. The current belief is that it is tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way (Little Cuba, Vice City). Do not chase unverified methods; check the cited guides for updates before spending time on it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.goal: UFO easter egg, Starlet Motel road, after 2AM
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go solo to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. Follow the path into the woods from the car to find the UFO (bright blue light), approach it, and it drops an abducted woman; talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: On any bike, kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and deliver the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across robberies; bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The fastest way is guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Any shop type counts.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are also 4 story garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) — buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Robberies are the fastest way to fund them.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garage parking first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes to keep the cost down.
